title: RBI imposes monetary penalty on Shri Baria Nagarik Sahakari Bank Ltd., Baria, Gujarat
description: The Reserve Bank of India (RBl) has, by an order dated July 17, 2026, imposed a monetary penalty of ₹1 lakh (Rupees One Lakh only) on Shri Baria Nagarik Sahakari Bank Ltd., Baria, Gujarat (the bank), for non-compliance with certain directions issued by RBI on ‘Inspection & Audit Systems in Primary (Urban) Co-operative Banks’.
